fields.summary_ko.0: Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) rose 9% on Friday, then gained an additional 5% on Monday, though trading below the 52-week high of $225, with CEO Musk's revenue guidance triggering the stock recovery.
fields.summary_ko.1: Musk forecasts annual revenue of $10 billion by December 2026 and $50 billion by December 2027, with 2027 EPS revised upward 132% from $1.77 to $4.10 in 30 days, representing +2,000% increase from FY26 $0.19 to FY27.
fields.summary_ko.2: SpaceX's P/S multiple remains elevated at approximately 52x, though Q3 revenue of $1.46 billion grew 161% YoY, with multi-year contract with Qualcomm for Starlink Mobile 5G infrastructure strengthening long-term growth.
